title: Saulus adhuc spirans (Konigsberg 7) (Richafort)
desc: Jean Richafort, Saulus adhuc spirans (Konigsberg 7). 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Konigsberg 7. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
